generation_review.prompt:
Draw exactly ONE new original Small Seal glyph using the attached four-specimen Unicode reference. The four labelled samples THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC all show ONE character. Study every AVAILABLE view equally, including small stroke junctions, bar lengths, counters and separate legs. An UNAVAILABLE blank is not evidence. Choose a coherent attested whole structure where sources vary; never mix incompatible alternatives, privilege THX, trace a single brush silhouette or substitute a modern Chinese character.

Create genuine, clean, smooth pen trajectories: BLACK strokes with the SAME CONSTANT WIDTH everywhere, approximately3% of the full square canvas. Shape only their centerline paths; no swelling, brush contrast, taper, pointed ends, roughness, texture, serifs, shadows or decoration. Roundcaps and smoothly rounded joins; controlled curves, generous open channels and counters. Preserve exact stroke inventory, meaningful short/long bar relationships, detachments and attachments.

Only ONE glyph centered in the central70% of a square TRANSPARENT canvas, ample margin. No labels, names, codepoints, text, numbers, reference copies, multiple variants, grid, background or border. The following explicit structural reading aid clarifies the character; it remains subordinate to all four historical specimens.

U+3D059 reading aid:
1. Left ritual: detached upper dash shorter than lower crossbar; center leg attached, flanks detached.
2. Upper right is an open rounded return hook: top course goes right, curves down and returns left; a separate middle-left course crosses near right turn and sweeps to a short down-right terminal. Keep three left-facing upper stroke ends at different levels, no closed top square.
3. A center stalk descends from upper return into TWO NESTED DOWNWARD-OPEN ARCHES. Outer arch has two long side ends; smaller inner arch has two shorter side ends; center stalk continues slightly below inner arch apex as a short middle end. Thus five open descending ends through this middle region, not closed windows.
4. Below arches is a SEPARATE lower group: broad rounded return hook starts at left, goes right, curves down and returns left.
5. A shorter middle-left course in that lower group crosses the return near right and continues into ONE long diagonal tail sweeping down-right. Keep its top-left, middle-left and lower-left-facing ends distinct.
6. No connection from lower group to the arches, no added enclosed lower box, and no extra descending tail. Choose one coherent flowing attested structure informed by all4 views.
Pay special attention to the central stalk through the two nested open arches and the three separate left-facing ends of BOTH return-hook regions. Use smooth real open pen strokes, rounded curves, uniform3%canvas diameter.
